fields.FIR_Description: A oral complaint dated 2026-05-31 states that unidentified persons allegedly damaged a parked car of the complainant near Iniyan Colony Apartment Complex at night, on 2026-05-30 at roughly 03:15. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000363. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, associate, CCTV, apartment complex, night, photograph
